## Proposed change
Allows customers that have left, and come back to Amber to select the correct site. Fixes: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/97309

To facilitate change, bumped `amberelectric` version to `1.1.0` which adds the site status. Changelog: https://github.com/madpilot/amberelectric.py/releases/tag/v1.1.0 (Diff: https://github.com/madpilot/amberelectric.py/pull/9/files)

issue_context.title: amberelectric integration - not handling inactive sites
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I'm using the Amber Electric integration. My account with Amber has two sites. In the API the first returned is marked as "closed" and the second as "active". The integration seems to be using the "closed" site's siteId. Here is the sites request response from the Amber API for my site (edited to remove the private info, obviously! :)): Sorry, I should be able to fix this myself but I'm not familiar with Python - I'm struggling to remember Java right now to fix a client issue.. :) Thank you to all those who work on HA and this integration. Hopefully I'll be able to put in in the future.

[sites_request_response.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/12178788/sites_request_response.txt)

2023.7.3

It's not quite as simple as "always use the active site". 

1) If you move house, the site may have different prices
2) There are customers with multiple active sites

We could poll the sites array once a day, and auto-discover new "active" sites and automatically create a new set of sensors for them?
Thanks, Myles. That would probably work. Good point about not always using the active site. Again, thanks for your work on this, and thanks if you find time to make a change at some point.

Hi, got this problem too, had to modify the config json manually, the selector for the site needs to be keyed by the site id not the NMI! it should say some info like NMI(active) instead of just the NMI

> Hi, got this problem too, had to modify the config json manually, the selector for the site needs to be keyed by the site id not the NMI! it should say some info like NMI(active) instead of just the NMI

Thanks - would you mind sharing your changes?

> Thanks - would you mind sharing your changes?

in the file `/.store/core.config_entries` and `/.store/core.entiry_registry` search for amberelectric and you will see the wrong site id, just replace with the correct one everywhere. Restart HA afterwards

ran into the same issue because I had an 'deactivated' property with the same NMI as I had been with amber, changed provider and then changed back to Amber. These instructions helped me solve the issue, but there is a bug in the setup, its clearly selecting by NMI and not site ID
PR to fix this issue is ready: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/104702

review_comments: Can someone actually use a closed site? If not I think it is better to filter them out
Yes. If they leave and want to monitor for when prices are cheaper to rejoin. Been a surprisingly popular feature and request.

I only have a question about the screenshot in the description, it shows two entries about `6001048264` (one active and one closed).

I understand if someone left and still wants to monitor it but what's the reason to select the closed one if you also have an active for that site?
I'm now filtering out closed sites which also have an active site.
